_schema.what: Claims withheld by the operator because their content is not in their source. Consumed by verify/publish.gate_claim: a listed claim is UNSUPPORTED with withheld_reason OPERATOR_WITHHELD and no binding runs. The direction is refuse-only -- this file can withhold, it can never admit.
_schema.rule: When a claim's content is not in its source, the default is to WITHHOLD THE CLAIM, not to find a source that supports it. Searching for evidence that fits a sentence a model wrote is the fabrication defect running backwards. A re-cite is legitimate only when the finding demonstrably exists and was attributed to the wrong document -- and the sentence itself does not name the wrong study.

columns.reason: what the source does not say
columns.checked_against: the source and the text that was read

_schema.register: every row has a line in docs/signal-corpus-freeze.md
